summary.business_type: Local Service Area Business (SAB) — Home Deep Cleaning, Gurgaon
top_findings: Prerender fix unblocks indexing — 40 URLs crawlable vs empty CSR previously
Missing llms.txt / AI crawler optimization — GEO score 45/100
414KB bootstrap.js (includes three.js) + 4 autoplay videos hurt mobile LCP
No verifiable GBP / map embed — local pack ceiling despite strong LocalBusiness schema
Full-home 1-5 BHK pages risk cannibalization — 61% duplicate chrome remaining
quick_wins: Add llms.txt + llms-full.txt and fix sitemap-images priority
Convert JPG to WebP/AVIF + srcset and defer three.js
Switch homepage title to keyword-first and make OG images page-specific
Embed GBP map + add visible NAP with postalCode and review link
Add BlogPosting + Author schema to 20 blog articles

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 40 URLs in live sitemap with fresh lastmod

findings.title: No security headers on GitHub Pages
findings.description: curl -I shows no HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options. GitHub Pages serves max-age=600 only.
findings.recommendation: Enable HSTS via Cloudflare proxy or add _headers via Netlify; increase cache-control for assets to 1y immutable.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 20 blog guides covering cost, BHK, checklist, sector

findings.title: BHK page cannibalization
findings.description: 1BHK-5BHK pages share 61% chrome and near-identical intent; titles differ only by BHK number.
findings.recommendation: Keep 1 canonical Full Home guide + BHK as anchors or add substantial unique proof/photos per BHK.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: H1 present with keyword, OG/Twitter complete

findings.title: Homepage title brand-first
findings.description: Sachin Deep Cleaning — Home... 56ch brand first vs keyword-first Deep Cleaning Services...
findings.recommendation: Change index.html:12 to Deep Cleaning Services in Gurgaon | Sachin Deep Cleaning

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Service + FAQPage + HowTo + Breadcrumb + Review ItemList per service

findings.title: BlogPosting schema missing
findings.description: blog/*.html only emits BreadcrumbList — no Article/BlogPosting, author, datePublished
findings.recommendation: Add BlogPosting JSON-LD with author Person, dateModified 2026-08-28, image

findings.title: 414KB JS includes three.js unused
findings.description: dist/assets/bootstrap-CtDAvBzZ.js 414KB decode cost delays INP on mobile; 4 autoplay videos inflate LCP.
findings.recommendation: Code-split three/drei, lazy-load videos, defer GT M, serve WebP with srcset.

findings.title: llms.txt 404
findings.description: GET /llms.txt returns 404 GitHub Pages. AI crawlers (GPTBot, Perplexity, Claude) lack allowlist.
findings.recommendation: Add public/llms.txt with site map + markdown and allow AI bots in robots.txt

findings.title: Only 1 WebP among 9 images
findings.description: sofa 172KB JPG, house 166KB JPG — no AVIF/WebP, no srcset.
findings.recommendation: Convert all to WebP+AVIF, add srcset/sizes, preload LCP.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Deploy llms.txt + update robots.txt to allow GPTBot/ClaudeBot
Fix homepage title + page-specific OG images

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: HSTS via Cloudflare + cache-control 1y for assets
Consolidate or differentiate 1-5 BHK pages with unique photos/checklists
Embed Google Map + visible NAP + GBP review link in footer

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add author bio pages (E-E-A-T) + publish dates
Build citations JustDial/IndiaMART/Sulekha with identical NAP
Internal link blog -> service with keyword-rich anchors (not View Details)
Create comparison page: Best Home Cleaning Services in Gurgaon

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Submit updated sitemap in GSC + request indexing for 40 URLs
Weekly CrUX via PageSpeed Insights, track LCP/INP
Drift baseline via SEO drift skill before next deploy
Collect 10+ real Google reviews to justify aggregateRating 247
